editorial:
Imagine you are almost done with your degree, and suddenly a world-famous crime writer shows up at your college. That is exactly what happens to Ashley, a creative writing student who just wants to finish her thesis. She ends up as the teaching assistant for Miles Blake, a man who knows everything there is to know about killing people on paper. The vibe starts off like a cozy campus drama, but it quickly turns into a game of cat and mouse. You will feel Ashley's excitement as she gets closer to her idol, but you will also feel that creeping sense that something is very wrong with Mr. Blake.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing about whether Miles is actually a killer or just playing a character. The pacing is snappy, though some of the plot twists feel a bit predictable if you watch a lot of thrillers. Still, the acting is solid and keeps the story moving. If you have a night free, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. Or, if you like owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this mystery on your shelf.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that Miles Blake was using Ashley to help him cover up a real crime. He wasn't just teaching her how to write; he was manipulating her to hide his tracks. In the final showdown, Ashley uses the very writing skills he taught her to outsmart him. She manages to gather enough evidence to expose his lies, leading to his arrest. The movie ends with her finally finishing her thesis and graduating, now a survivor rather than just a student.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves murder mysteries and college settings.
